description: One self-hosted artifact registry in one install: Harbor (container images and OCI Helm charts, with Trivy scanning) + Terralist (a private Terraform/OpenTofu module and provider registry). Every image is QuenchWorks-hardened, nonroot, 0-CVE, pinned by digest and cosign-signed.

Operator-managed HA PostgreSQL in one install: the CloudNativePG operator + a replicated Cluster (streaming replication, automated failover, built-in metrics) + a PgBouncer Pooler in front of the primary. Every image is QuenchWorks-hardened, nonroot, 0-CVE, pinned by digest and cosign-signed.
